paper.title: Stochastic Bandit Models for Delayed Conversions

unmapped: Each pull triggers a Bernoulli(theta_k) conversion revealed after a random delay D_t with known CDF tau shared by all arms
Conversions with delay larger than the window m are censored (never observed); m known to learner
Ambiguity between non-conversion and not-yet-observed conversion
settings.definition_quote: The model with $m$-thresholded delays takes into account the fact that a conversion can only be observed within $m$ steps after the action occurred. ... $C_t | \mathcal{H}_{t-1} \sim \operatorname{Bernoulli}(\theta_{A_t})$, $D_t | \mathcal{H}_{t-1} \sim$ distribution with CDF $\tau$

unmapped: Each pull triggers a Bernoulli(theta_k) conversion revealed after a random, possibly unbounded delay with known CDF tau shared by all arms and finite mean mu
settings.definition_quote: At each round t, the learner chooses an arm A_t. This action simultaneously triggers two independent random variables: C_t in {0,1} ... the conversion indicator ...; D_t in N, the delay ... $Y_t = \sum_{s=1}^t C_s \mathds{1}\{D_s = t-s \}$

symbols.tau_m: probability that the delay is at most m, P(D <= m)

source.label: th:lb-cens
source.quote: The regret of any uniformly efficient algorithm is bounded from below by \[ \liminf_{T \to \infty} \frac{R(T)}{\log(T)} \geq \sum_{k\neq k^*} \frac{\tau_m(\theta^* - \theta_k)}{d(\tau_m \theta_k, \tau_m \theta^*)} . \]

results.notes: Regret L(T) defined via means weighted by tau, i.e. pseudo-regret.

conditions: expected delay mu = E[D] is finite

source.label: th:lb-uncens
source.quote: The regret of any uniformly efficient algorithm in the Uncensored Delays Setting is bounded from below by \[ \liminf_{T \to \infty} \frac{R(T)}{\log(T)} \geq \sum_{k\neq k^*} \frac{(\theta^* - \theta_k)}{d(\theta_k, \theta^*)} . \]

results.notes: Proof uses finiteness of the expected delay.

symbols.tau_m: probability that the delay is at most m, P(D <= m)

source.label: th:ucb
source.quote: In the censored setting, the regret of \delayedUCB\ is bounded from above by \[ L_{\textsc{ucb}}(T)\leq (1+\epsilon)\log(T)\sum_{k \neq \ast} \frac{1}{2\tau_m\Delta_k} + o_{\epsilon,m}(\log (T)). \]

results.notes: Bound is leading term plus o(log T); recorded as limsup of R/log T. Algorithm needs delay CDF and m (unmapped).

conditions: there exists c > 0 such that 1 - tau_m <= c/m for all m >= 1

source.label: cor:uncensUCB
source.quote: In the uncensored setting, we also assume that there exists $c >0$ such that $1-\tau_m \leq \frac{c}{m}$ for all $m \geq 1$. Then, is bounded from above by \[ L_{\textsc{ucb}}(T)\leq \frac{1+\epsilon}{1-\epsilon}\log(T)\sum_{k>1} \frac{1}{2\Delta_k} + o_{\epsilon,m}(\log (T)) . \]

symbols.tau_m: probability that the delay is at most m, P(D <= m)

source.label: th:klucb
source.quote: For any $\eta >0$, the regret of \delayedKLUCB\ is bounded in the censored setting as L_{\textsc{klucb}}(T)\leq (1+\eta)\frac{\beta_\epsilon (t)}{1-\theta_1}\sum_{k > 1} \frac{\tau_m\Delta_k}{d(\tau_m\theta_k, \tau_m\theta_1)} + o_{\epsilon,m,\eta}(\log (T)).

results.notes: Theorem writes beta_eps(t); interpreted as (1+eps) log T. Appendix proof actually yields factor 1/(1 - tau_m*theta_1), tighter than stated 1/(1-theta_1).

bound.expression: (1 + eps_alg)*log(T)/(1 - mu_star)*sum_subopt((1 + eta_an)*(1 - eps_alg)*Delta_i/kl((1 - eps_alg)*mu_i, (1 - eps_alg)*mu_star))

conditions: there exists c such that 1 - tau_m <= c/m for all m >= 1

source.quote: In the uncensored setting, under the same hypothesis than in Corollary~\ref{cor:uncensUCB}, namely that there exists a constant $c$ such that $1-\tau_m\leq \frac{c}{m}$ for all $m\leq 1$. Then, the regret of \delayedKLUCB\ is bounded from above as L_{\textsc{klucb}}(T) \leq \frac{\beta_\epsilon(t)}{1-\theta_1} \sum_{k > 1} \frac{(1+\eta)(1-\epsilon)\Delta_k}{d((1-\epsilon)\theta_k, (1-\epsilon)\theta_1)} + o_{\eta,\epsilon}(\log(T)).

results.notes: Paper writes 'm <= 1', presumably a typo for m >= 1. beta_eps(t) interpreted as (1+eps) log T; the same eps is used in the exploration function and in tau_m >= 1-eps in the statement.
